reviews.title: Mixed results.
reviews.comment:
I bought two 8 GB sticks as part of a new PC I am building to be compatible with Windows 11.  When I put all of the components together and turned it on the PC would not boot to load Windows. After double-chevking all motherboard connections and still no boot I pulled the rear RAM stick out and the PC booted fine. It turns out the PC would not boot if the defective RAM stick was installed alone or one of a pair.
The good news is a product return and refund was authorized and I reordered the same Corsair DDR5 sticks, got overnight delivery,  and the new sticks are installed and running  just fine.  2 X 8 = 16 GB.  I can’t speak to over-clocking, etc.  I am not a gamer.
reviews.author: Orv
